description_en: Queries the latency of data replication between a primary instance and its read-only instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS只读实例的延迟信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-read-db-instance-delay --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-bp0000 --read-instance-id rr-bp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeReadDBInstanceDelay

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The primary instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the primary instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The read-only instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the read-only instance ID
parameters.name: read_instance_id
